messages.subject: Security and Privacy on shinyapps.io
parts:
Hi,

I'm currently developing an extensive shiny app which I intend to release in a couple of months. I need to temporarily host a prototype version online but don't want to reveal any of the code from the server function. When apps are hosted on shinyapps.io, does the server function remain private or can the user access it?

Cheers,
John

messages.author: 299a5089d6c6c523
messages.subject: Re: Security and Privacy on shinyapps.io
parts: Even with public applications, none of the code is visible to the users of the application.
